title: HVAC / HEPA / ULPA
summary: Comfort and cleanroom-grade filtration for buildings, clean zones and critical spaces.
paragraphs: In HVAC systems, filtration protects equipment, reduces dust and pollen load and sustains indoor air quality. HEPA and ULPA filters are used where high particle capture is required — for example in laboratories, hospitals and clean manufacturing zones.

Selecting the right filter class, ensuring airtight installation and replacing filters on schedule are essential to keep design air quality and energy efficiency. Differential pressure monitoring helps operators know when a filter has reached its change-out point.
